name: io.github.WYRE-AI/bitdefender-mcp
title: Bitdefender GravityZone
description: MCP server for Bitdefender GravityZone's JSON-RPC API.

environmentVariables.name: BITDEFENDER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bitdefender GravityZone API key, generated in Control Center -> My Account -> API keys, with the Network/Policies/Reports/Incidents APIs selected.

environmentVariables.name: BITDEFENDER_ACCESS_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Control Center Access URL (My Account -> Control Center API), e.g. https://cloud.gravityzone.bitdefender.com.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
